correctness.rationale: For P_m one root below m incomparable leaves, upsets form all subsets of leaves plus W. For any one-variable formula, S=∅ and S=W produce Boolean outputs (2 choices each), S=L has 3 automorphism-invariant choices, and proper nonempty S⊂L has 5 stabilizer-invariant outputs (∅,S,L minus S,L,W). These bounds are valid at all formula depths. Co-implication test C(A)=top prec A yields W iff A != W, and Boolean selectors constructed from C(p), C(¬p), C(¬¬p) isolate empty/full/all-leaf/mixed valuation types. The 2*2*3*5=60 independent normal forms therefore achieve the upper bound for m≥2, reducing to 12 for one leaf and 4 for zero leaves. Independent algebraic closure and pointwise Kripke calculations for m=0..4 matched 4,12,60,60,60; their finite scope does not establish all m, which follows from stabilizer and selectors.
